releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.13
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.13

This alpha update adds a floating game window and automatic Android keyboard support. It also reduces background CPU use and fixes several touch and graphics issues.

Install over your existing version to keep your data.

## What's new

- **Floating game window** is on by default. When you switch apps, the game can keep playing in Android's picture-in-picture window, capped at 20 FPS. Tap the window and use its expand button to return to full screen. You can turn it off in Settings. The background setting is now called **Keep running in background**.
- The Android keyboard opens when a WoW text field gains focus and closes when you finish typing. It stays closed while a hardware keyboard is connected.
- The game surface requests 60 Hz while you play, including during touch input, to reduce display power use on high-refresh-rate phones. WeHavePhones also cleans up leftover Wine processes shortly after a session ends.
- **Disable WoW voice chat** is on by default to reduce background CPU use. Turn it off in Settings if you use WoW's built-in voice chat.

## Touch controls

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.12
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.12

An alpha update fixing a controller regression in 0.0.11.

Install over your existing version to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.**

## Touch controls

- The action wheel is now enabled by default on wide screens. Turn off **Menu → Touch controls → Action wheel** to use standard action bars. Existing saved choices are preserved.

## Fixes

- Moving the left stick on a controller no longer presses the D-pad too, so D-pad bindings in WoW only fire from the D-pad. This fixes a regression in 0.0.11 (#39).

## Validation

- All 14 host suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.
- Forever 1.60.1.70938 passed in the signed 0.0.12 RC on a Galaxy S23+. Controller UI persisted after an in-game exit and relaunch. World entry and jumping passed with default controls.
- Touch controls passed world entry, jumping, stick movement and camera turning. The wheel passed swipes in both directions, hub taps and casting Healing Touch from an existing slot.
- Settings were restored and controller UI returned after the touch tests. No new Android crash entries appeared.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.11
releases.body:
An alpha update with redesigned touch controls, lower graphics memory use and controller fixes.

Install over 0.0.10 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Major change to touch controls

The new touch action wheels have four rings of nine slots using WoW's Action Bars 6 to 8. Swipe around the hub or tap it to change rings, tap a slot to use it, and hold a slot to change it.

**Existing touch-control users may need to re-add their spells and items to the new wheels.**

![Redesigned touch controls with the action wheel](https://github.com/ashmerra/wehavephones/releases/download/v0.0.11/WeHavePhones-0.0.11-touch-controls.png)

## What's new

- Added 75%, 90% and 110% touch interface sizes. The movement stick, toolbar and other native touch controls now resize with the interface, at a gentler rate to keep them easy to tap.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.10
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on touch controls, launch reliability and addon apps.

Install over 0.0.9 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Changes

- Touch chat starts compact when you enter the world and expands when you use it. Its controls stay clear of page keys and the keyboard.
- The touch quest tracker sits below the player frame. Play-mode drags turn the character, and the current touch mode is easier to see.
- Fixed taps missing their target when the Android keyboard pans the game screen.
- Fixed an exited WoW process blocking the next launch.
- Disabled Wine audio codec drivers that delayed Battle.net startup. Previous controlled S23 measurements reached the Play button about six seconds sooner.
- Fixed WowUp hanging at its logo with a backport of Wine's large-message fix. Removed the obsolete WowUp app patch.
- Added automated game and addon app checks for contributors.

## Testing and limitations

- All 13 host check suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.9
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on Forever touch controls, launch frame pacing and diagnostics.

Install over 0.0.8 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install it for you.

## What's new

- Battle.net and the launch screens now run at 30 FPS to reduce rendering work before WoW starts. The cap lifts automatically when WoW starts, so gameplay is unaffected.
- Diagnostics now includes Android's recorded reasons for recent app exits, helping identify low-memory closures and crashes. Available on Android 11 and later.
- Added experimental Turnip Gen8 V38 as a manual graphics driver choice on Adreno 7xx phones.

## Touch control fixes

- Forever now receives the touch layout, with chat, player frames and hotbars positioned clear of the touch buttons.
- Forever's controller and gamepad interface now turn off when launching with touch controls. Turning touch controls off restores your previous controller settings on the next launch.
- Fixed "Interface action failed because of an AddOn" errors caused by the Forever touch layout during combat.
- Fixed Forever's hidden quest tracker and quests disappearing when selecting a target.

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.4.1
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Game updates
- **Use update** in the settings of a game, under Update, turns its installed update off, and the game runs as its base version. It's only shown for games with an update, and applies the next time the game starts. The game card shows the version the game runs as
- Games whose update doesn't work in Cemu have it off by default, with a note under the switch saying it's recommended off. **Why?** opens the reason

### Fixes
- ZombiU no longer stays on a black screen after the Ubisoft logo. Its update (v32) doesn't work in Cemu, so it's off by default and ZombiU runs as its base version


## Frame generation setup
1. Copy `Lossless.dll` from your own copy of Lossless Scaling (its installation folder on Windows) to your device.
2. In Cemu Plus open **Settings → Graphics settings → Frame generation (Lossless Scaling)** and tap **Select Lossless.dll**.
3. Enable frame generation there or from the in-game menu, where the multiplier, target frame rate and motion estimation resolution can be changed while playing.

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.4.0
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Motion sensitivity
- **Motion sensitivity X axis** and **Motion sensitivity Y axis** set how fast turning left and right, and tilting up and down go, from 25% to 500%. They are next to the motion inversion on each controller's page in **Input settings** and in the quick menu under Controls, and work for the motion of the device and of controllers
- They scale the turning speed the game gets, which is what aiming with motion uses. A tilt that is held still settles at the real angle of the device

### Updated to the latest Cemu
Cemu Plus now includes everything the main Cemu project added since April 2026:
- **Wii U CPU on ARM:** fixes in the ARM64 recompiler that runs every game, for single-precision float stores (now faster too), division by zero, carry flags and a few wrong instructions. The default NaN mode of ARM is turned off to match the Wii U
- **Performance:** smaller Vulkan and GPU optimizations, like checking only the render state that changed, caching shader lookups and using the fast draw path more often

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.3.6-beta.2
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## Frame generation setup
1. Copy `Lossless.dll` from your own copy of Lossless Scaling (its installation folder on Windows) to your device.
2. In Cemu Plus open **Settings → Graphics settings → Frame generation (Lossless Scaling)** and tap **Select Lossless.dll**.
3. Enable frame generation there or from the in-game menu, where the multiplier, target frame rate and motion estimation resolution can be changed while playing.

Frame generation requires the Vulkan memory model, float16 and null descriptor support from the GPU driver.
The FPS overlay shows the displayed frame rate together with the base frame rate while frame generation is active.

**Full changelog:** [v0.3.5...v0.3.6-beta.2](https://github.com/danielcamilo1/cemu-plus/compare/v0.3.5...v0.3.6-beta.2)

releases.name: Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.15
releases.body:
## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.15: más rendimiento

### Cambios

- **Más rendimiento en procesadores con 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88/G99, MT6769/MT6789 y similares). En la versión anterior dejamos de fijar los hilos del juego a los núcleos rápidos en estos procesadores, y en algunos volvió el lag. Ahora el hilo principal del juego, el que más trabaja, va en los núcleos rápidos, y los demás hilos los reparte Android. Con 4 o más núcleos rápidos no cambia nada: todos los hilos van en ellos.
- **Menos trabajo inútil en cada fotograma.** El juego pregunta por `d3d9.dll` en cada fotograma, y el port lo anotaba en el registro cada vez: unas 2000 líneas por segundo en Most Wanted y Carbon. Ahora se anota una sola vez. Otras líneas repetitivas (texturas convertidas en la CPU, entrada de teclado, liberación de superficies) también se limitan. Además de ahorrar CPU, el registro de los reportes conserva lo importante.

Dos APK: **arm64** y **armeabi-v7a**. Android 10+, Vulkan 1.1+. Misma firma; se instalan como actualización. Se adjunta `NFSU1-v0.2.15-SHA256SUMS.txt`.

releases.name: Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.14
releases.body:
## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.14: rendimiento recuperado

### Cambios

- **Rendimiento recuperado en procesadores con solo 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88, MT6769 y similares). Desde la versión anterior, todos los hilos del juego se fijaban a los núcleos rápidos. En estos procesadores eso los metía todos en solo 2 núcleos, y el juego iba peor que antes. Ahora solo se fijan cuando hay al menos 4 núcleos rápidos; si no, Android los reparte como antes.
- **Reportes más completos.** Se guardan las tres últimas sesiones del registro del juego, no solo dos: muchos jugadores reabren el juego un par de veces tras un cierre antes de reportar, y la sesión del cierre se perdía. En el resumen del issue, las trazas del cierre van abreviadas para que quepan más líneas del juego.

Dos APK: **arm64** y **armeabi-v7a**. Android 10+, Vulkan 1.1+. Misma firma; se instalan como actualización. Se adjunta `NFSU1-v0.2.14-SHA256SUMS.txt`.

releases.name: Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.13
releases.body:
## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.13: driver recomendado para tu GPU

### Driver Vulkan recomendado para tu procesador

- **El launcher te dice qué driver usar.** En *Opciones › Driver Vulkan* ahora aparece la GPU de tu teléfono y el driver que le conviene:
  - **Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx):** Turnip (Mesa), si el driver del sistema va lento o con errores gráficos.
  - **MediaTek, Exynos, Tensor o Unisoc con Mali-G57 o más nueva:** PanVK (Mesa), con la misma condición.
  - **Mali-G52/G72/G76 o más antiguas:** el driver del sistema (PanVK aún es experimental en ellas).
  - **PowerVR (Moto g54, Helio G35/G37…) y Samsung Xclipse:** el driver del sistema. No hay un driver alternativo que funcione en ellas.
- **Aviso si el driver no es para tu GPU.** Si eliges un driver hecho para otra GPU (por ejemplo, Turnip en una Mali o PanVK en una Adreno), el launcher avisa de que el juego probablemente no arrancará.

La app no incluye ningún driver: los importas tú como ZIP (adrenotools) desde el mismo diálogo.

Dos APK: **arm64** y **armeabi-v7a**. Android 10+, Vulkan 1.1+. Misma firma; se instalan como actualización. Se adjunta `NFSU1-v0.2.13-SHA256SUMS.txt`. Incluye todo lo de la v0.2.12.

releases.name: Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.12
releases.body:
## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.12: volver al juego sin cierres y reportes completos

### Correcciones

- **Cierre al volver al juego.** Si salías a otra app y volvías, el juego podía cerrarse en el primer fotograma. Android libera la ventana del juego al pasar a segundo plano, pero la superficie Vulkan seguía usándola y se destruía después. Ahora la superficie conserva su ventana hasta que se destruye.

### Reportes más útiles

- **El resumen del issue ya trae las líneas del juego.** Antes se tomaban de logcat y, cuando pulsabas *Reportar*, Android ya las había borrado: casi todos los issues llegaban con "últimas líneas del juego" vacío. Ahora salen del registro propio del juego (`game.log`), y logcat solo aporta las líneas del cierre.
- **Lecturas de archivo incompletas en el registro.** Si el juego pide más datos de los que recibe de un archivo, se anota el archivo, la posición y su tamaño. Así podremos ver si un cierre viene de un archivo del juego dañado o incompleto.

### Ajustes para teléfonos con GPU débil

releases.name: Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.11
releases.body:
## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.11: mega actualización

Revisamos los reportes y los zip de diagnóstico que nos enviaron. Esta versión trae las mismas mejoras de fondo que Most Wanted y Underground 2.

### Estabilidad

- **Lecturas de archivos completas.** En algunos teléfonos, Android entregaba los archivos del juego a trozos y el juego tomaba un archivo a medias por uno completo, lo que podía cerrar el juego al cargar. Ahora se lee hasta el final.
- **Protección para GPU PowerVR (MediaTek, p. ej. Moto g54 / Dimensity 7020).** El driver Vulkan de MediaTek se caía al crear el primer pipeline gráfico. Ahora, si el driver falla, el port reintenta con configuraciones más simples hasta encontrar una que funcione. *No hemos podido probarlo en un teléfono PowerVR; si tienes uno, cuéntanos cómo va.*

### Audio

- **Menos saturación.** El mezclador ya no corta el sonido en seco cuando se suman muchos sonidos; ahora lo comprime con suavidad.

### Rendimiento

- **Hilos del juego en los núcleos rápidos.** Se fijan a los núcleos grandes y se le indica a Android cuánto dura cada fotograma (ADPF).

### Controles

- **El botón A del mando también hace Enter** mientras conduces.

releases.name: 4.0.4 - November 3, 2026
releases.body:
## 4.0.4 - November 3, 2026
* **The left analog stick now moves the pointer in the menus**, on every controller, like a mouse. It no longer also steps through the buttons; the D-pad still does
* **A Wiimote with anything plugged into it is now always vertical in the menus**, and its buttons and IR pointer work alongside the extension (a Nunchuk on Wii and a Classic Controller on both Wii and Wii U previously lost them)
* **Redesigned Button Mappings screen.** One screen now replaces the separate controller and button screens, showing each button on a drawing of the controller and letting you choose a button by pressing it or from a list.
* **Redesigned Saves screen.** The Save, Load and Delete buttons are now a single **Saves** button. Snapshots fill a grid, with the game's **Cartridge Save** (shown only for games that have one) in its own card beneath. Choosing a card opens a small popover of what can be done with it; the save file's backups are listed from its popover. The Auto Load, Auto Save and Append Auto settings are replaced by a single **Save Mode**: **Snapshot** (the default), **Cartridge Save**, or **Manual**.

releases.name: 4.0.3 - October 20, 2026
releases.body:
* **New menu look!** The menus have been rebuilt with a fresh, modern style: a deeper red header and footer, cleaner rounded buttons with soft shadows, a redesigned game list with a slimmer scrollbar and a clear highlight on the selected entry, new prompt windows, and more. The menu graphics are now drawn procedurally by the renderer instead of being loaded from PNG images, so they stay sharp at any output resolution
* **New controller status bar** in the menu footer, replacing the Wiimote battery icons. Each of the four player slots (P1-P4) now shows the type of controller connected (Wiimote, GameCube controller, etc.), with the battery level shown for Wiimote controllers and the Gamepad. Empty slots appear dimmed
* Wii U: Japanese/Korean/Chinese fonts are now also found in `fceugx/` or `wiiu/apps/fceugx/` on the SD card even before settings have been saved, and stay crisp at 1080p
* Wii U: fix texture reuse causing cover art issues with varying image sizes

releases.body:
* **Native Wii U release!** FCE Ultra GX now runs natively on the Wii U as its own app, with its own icon on the Wii U Menu. Requires [Aroma](https://wiiu.hacks.guide/) - run the latest Aroma release and launch the `.wuhb` directly from it
  * Output up to 1080p, with a new GPU-powered **ScaleFX** upscaler shader and a **Sharp Bilinear** shader, plus a scanline shader
  * Crisp, upscaled menus with sharper text and HD artwork
  * Full **Wii U GamePad** support - touch screen, buttons, and rumble - alongside Wiimote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller, and Wii U Pro Controller
  * Correct 16:9 aspect ratio handling, with Wii U aspect ratio handling
  * SD card plus up to 3 USB drives at once, with hotplug. USB supports FAT32, exFAT, and NTFS (requires [Mocha](https://github.com/wiiu-env/MochaPayload), an optional Aroma component)
  * Press the HOME button to open the Wii U menu overlay. In game, HOME still opens the app menu.
  * Sound plays on both the TV and the GamePad
  * Recommended: install [Bloopair](https://github.com/GaryOderNichts/Bloopair) to pair Bluetooth controllers (Switch Pro, Joy-Con, DualShock/DualSense, Xbox, and more) as if they were a Wii U Pro Controller

releases.name: v0.2.24
releases.body:
Text input fix, frame output setting, lighter textures on Mali and PowerVR.

## English

**New**
- ⚙ → "Frame output on its own thread": Auto / On / Off (applies on next launch). Auto works as in 0.2.22: on, and switched off by itself only if that thread really crashes twice. The phone closing the game to save battery does not count.

**Fixed**
- Naming a hero: OK no longer stays grey with "finish choosing characters" while the cursor is at the end of the name (Gboard, SwiftKey and other Latin keyboards).

**Improved**
- Mali and PowerVR phones: textures are unpacked on the GPU with a checked decoder and kept in a compact format, so they take less video memory. Nothing changes on Snapdragon (Adreno).
- If the graphics driver fails, the log now says why, which helps fix such crashes.

**Install:** installs over any earlier version and keeps your saves; no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `Diablo3-Mobile-v0.2.24-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Новое**

releases.name: v0.2.23
releases.body:
Faster drawing on Mali and PowerVR.

## English

**Improved**
- Mali and PowerVR phones: the lighter way of drawing from the test build 0.2.11-test4 is now in the release (#4). The GPU skips saving and reloading parts of the frame nobody needs and waits less between drawing steps. Testers on Helio G99 and Dimensity 7050 went from about 30 to 45–60 fps. Nothing changes on Snapdragon (Adreno).
- Everything from 0.2.22 stays: camera zoom-out, LAN play, the newer drivers.

**Install:** installs over any earlier version and keeps your saves; no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `Diablo3-Mobile-v0.2.23-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Улучшено**
- Телефоны на Mali и PowerVR: более лёгкая отрисовка из тестовой сборки 0.2.11-test4 теперь в релизе (#4). Видеокарта не сохраняет и не перечитывает ненужные части кадра и меньше ждёт между этапами отрисовки. У тестеров на Helio G99 и Dimensity 7050 было около 30 fps, стало 45–60. На Snapdragon (Adreno) ничего не меняется.
- Всё из 0.2.22 на месте: отдаление камеры, игра по локальной сети, новые драйверы.

releases.name: v0.2.22
releases.body:
Camera zoom-out, smoother frame delivery.

## English

**New**
- ⚙ → "Camera zoom-out" (100–140 %, changes live): moves the camera back to show more around the hero, at the same angle; the interface keeps its size (#31). 100 % = as on the Switch, about 120 % = as far as on the PC. More of the world on the screen means more GPU load.

**Improved**
- Frames are handed to the screen on a separate thread, so the game's main graphics thread has more time for the next frame. This helps most where the CPU is the limit (a hot phone, slower CPUs). If this ever makes the game crash, the port switches it off by itself after the second such crash.
- A fix for how the game's threads end.

**Install:** no new game patches, no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `Diablo3-Mobile-v0.2.22-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Новое**
- ⚙ → «Отдаление камеры» (100–140 %, меняется сразу): камера отъезжает назад, и вокруг героя видно больше, угол тот же; интерфейс прежнего размера (#31). 100 % — как на Switch, около 120 % — как на ПК. Чем больше мира на экране, тем выше нагрузка на GPU.

**Улучшено**

releases.name: v0.2.21
releases.body:
Damaged game files are found and named, a slightly faster graphics engine.

## English

**New**
- If the game crashed before the picture appeared, the next start checks the game files once (up to a minute, with progress on screen). A file of the right size but with damaged contents (usually a bad copy to the phone) is named on the screen, so you know which one to copy again (#33). The check runs only after such a crash, and files that passed are not checked again.

**Improved**
- The graphics engine is built with stronger optimization: a little less CPU time per frame.

**Install:** no new game patches, no setup re-run needed. Android 10 or 11: `Diablo3-Mobile-v0.2.21-arm64-android10.apk`.

## Русский

**Новое**
- Если игра вылетела до появления картинки, при следующем запуске она один раз проверяет файлы игры (до минуты, проценты на экране). Файл правильного размера, но с испорченным содержимым (обычно из-за неудачного копирования на телефон), будет назван на экране — понятно, какой перекопировать (#33). Проверка запускается только после такого вылета, прошедшие её файлы повторно не проверяются.

**Улучшено**

releases.body:
This release finalizes the 5.0 series.

Emulation accuracy
- New option CPU_START_DELAY staggers the CPU start relative to the beam. Without it, some memory configurations always hit a timing race in Kickstart 1.3’s PAL/NTSC detection (#1029).
- Reinstated the ADF track-length fix that had been dropped by mistake (#1021).

Usability
- Improved auto-warp condition (#1008).
- “Close unsaved instances without asking” now works reliably.
- Choosing the Performance preset no longer wipes the saved collision-detection defaults.

Under the hood
- Public API cleanup
- Detailed API documentation at https://dirkwhoffmann.github.io/vAmiga/docs/index.html

Enhancements: 
- Moira now emulates the 68020 instruction cache.

Bug fixes:
- Improved AGA support (#999, #1003, #1004, #1009, #1011, #1012, #1013).

New features: 
- AGA support

# Release Notes

## Enhancements

- The floppy disk API now supports disk images stored in memory buffers (#992)
- Added proper gamma correction to the palette builders (#998)
- Replaced the 4096-entry palette lookup table with a smaller table based on an affine transformation, paving the way for AGA support.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug that caused the server launch daemon to fire every cycle (#990)
- Fixed a bug that prevented preferences from loading correctly (#995)
- Added guard checks for potential Swift `nil` values
- Fixed a bug in the **Export to…** menu (#989)
- Reverted pull request #837 (#984)

Ending the beta phase, as no severe bugs have been reported recently.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed an issue that prevented folders from being imported as hard drives (#975)

releases.body:
**Test build, not a normal release.** Made for the Mangmi Air X (Adreno 610) and other devices where "Vulkan could not be loaded" appears.

Some phones' graphics drivers advertise a debug extension (VK_EXT_debug_utils) without providing its functions. The app used to treat that as fatal and fall back to the slow OpenGL renderer. In this build that extension is optional, so Vulkan can start.

This build also contains the Retro Rewind login fix from test 2 (the game now waits up to 5 seconds for the login reply).

Install it over your current DriftDroid. Your settings and saves stay. Open the game, then press "Export Diagnostics" on the main screen and attach the zip, even if it works. If Vulkan still fails, the log shows what failed next.

It is built from commit f15608e. The Dawn change is not in the repository yet; it will be added as a patch file.

releases.name: 1.4.0 login test 2 (pre-release)
releases.body:
**Test build, not a normal release.** For people who got Retro Rewind error 20100 when going online. This replaces test 1, which did not work.

## ✨ A calmer, clearer CosmoU

CosmoU 0.13 reworks the whole interface. All the features are still there, just sorted better, so every window and every theme feels like one product: easy to understand on the first start, calm with a big library, readable from the sofa.

- **Play is always the strongest button** – in Covers, Grid, the Wii U Look and the game details. Details and the other actions are quieter.

Snap64 Recomp 1.1.8-test1 (test build for issue 39)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for [issue 39](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/39): on a phone with an Exynos 2400, the Android app shows the same graphics message at every start once Anti-Aliasing is set to 8x. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is the code that will become 1.1.8, as it stands today. When the phone cannot make a picture buffer at the settings chosen, the port lowers a setting and asks for a restart. 1.1.7 only ever lowered Super Sampling, so with Super Sampling already at 1x nothing changed and every start ended the same way. This build lowers one setting each time: Super Sampling, then Anti-Aliasing, then Color Depth, then Render Scale. It never asks for an Anti-Aliasing level the phone does not offer, it remembers a level that failed, and the log names the levels the phone offers.

Install it over 1.1.7. Saves stay. If 1.1.7 left the phone stuck, the first start of this build should lower Anti-Aliasing to 4x by itself and get into the game. If it still stops, attach `snap64.log` from Internal storage > Snap64 to issue 39.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test4 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is [1.1.7-test3](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7-test3) with a fix for the crash that build recorded. The Thor's graphics driver crashed at the end of the first drawing pass of the first frame. That pass held a reset of the renderer's timers, which Vulkan does not allow inside a drawing pass. The port's own clear of new picture buffers had left the pass open. Now the reset, and the two other steps Vulkan keeps outside a drawing pass, close an open pass first. The log says so once.

The crash record from test3 stays in. If the app still closes, open it once more, then attach `snap64.log` to issue 36. Saves stay.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test3 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It does not fix the crash. It records it. [1.1.7-test2](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7-test2) answered the first fault on the Thor, a table of textures the driver refused. The app still closes a moment later, and the log has no line for it. This build writes the reason into `snap64.log`:

- When the app closes on a fault, it writes the signal, the thread, the graphics call that thread was in, and the code addresses.
- At the next start, it copies in Android's own report of how the last run ended.

To help: install it over what you have, open it, let it close, open it once more, then attach `snap64.log` to issue 36. Saves stay.

releases.body:

Three guards came with it: a refused table is no longer written to, and clears and scissors are kept inside what Vulkan allows. The log says more about what the driver answers. The change is attached as `plume-issue36.patch`.

The APK is signed with the project's key, so it installs over 1.1.7 and saves stay. Android's app info shows it as 1.1.7-test2.

It has been checked on Android's emulator only. The same game code passed the Android checks, 114 of 114. ## OpenROM v4.1.0

Universal Retro Gaming Toolkit for retro gaming enthusiasts.

Each download includes:
- **OpenROM** — Flutter desktop GUI
- **openrom-core** — headless CLI (used internally by the GUI)

```
openrom-core --detect game.iso
openrom-core --input game.iso --format CHD

releases.name: MHGU Relink 0.2.5
releases.body:

- 右摇杆：修复显示右摇杆后无法转视角（原生相机处理被误跳过）；默认隐藏且隐藏时不接收触摸，放出来后按原生右摇杆转动镜头。

Includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1, and Tribes of the East 3.1. Requires Android 8.0 or later, an ARM64 device, and the original PC game files. Android version code **15**.

## Startup and launcher

- Added **3D main menu** and **Fast main menu** options. Turn off the 3D background to use a solid color, or enable fast startup to use the menu while the 3D scene loads between frames. Both options take effect on the next launch.
- Selecting a parent folder containing GOG Gold and Tribes of the East can set up all three editions in one step. The launcher keeps existing working game paths.
- ZIP imports now check the MD5 when the checksum is included in the archive filename and report mismatches.
- The launcher adapts to wide windows with a two-column layout and accepts custom Vulkan drivers in ZIP or `.so` format.
- On Xiaomi HyperOS, the launcher offers a shortcut to Game Turbo before autostart. The tip can be dismissed and reopened from About.

## Touch controls and interface

- Interface scale is now a dropdown from **50% to 200%** in **25%** steps. A value saved by the old slider stays in effect until you select a new value.

releases.name: Heroes V v0.8-dev
releases.body:
Speeds up AI turns and dense OpenGL ES map views, improves graphics and saves, and restores optional DXVK/Turnip rendering. One APK includes Heroes V 1.6, Hammers of Fate 2.1 and Tribes of the East 3.1.

Android version `0.8-dev` / code `13`, signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.7-dev:

- Enable **Fast AI turn** by default. AI estimates avoid repeatedly serializing and checksumming the map's object-name table during rollbacks. Restored entries are checked; a mismatch disables the shortcut for the process. The original path is used after the first network socket opens. Find the switch under **Settings > Additional > Controls**, between Split zones and Order confirmation. This speeds up calculations, not hero animations or AI difficulty.
- Grow the OpenGL ES upload ring when consecutive frames outgrow it, avoiding repeated per-draw allocations in dense adventure views.
- Move common DLL code into `libhomm5_common.so`, saving about 43 MB after all three engines have been unpacked. Add native vertex, lighting, battle-grid and byte-compatible deflate paths.

Android version `0.7-dev` / code `12`; signed with the existing APK update certificate.

Changes since 0.6-dev:

- Preview movement paths and destination cells before issuing a battle order. Paths follow the original prepared command, preserving obstacle detours, terrain height and flight paths. Strike and Return shows separate outgoing and returning lanes. Route previews are enabled by default and work independently of confirmation.
- Add optional battle order confirmation. Taps and gestures select movement, melee attacks, shots or spells; a separate button above the right-side action panel executes the selected order. Wait and Defend retain their immediate buttons. Confirmation is disabled by default.

- Restore the original camera with a three-finger tap in adventure, battle, deployment and town, including over the interface. Deployment accounts for the current phase and player side.

Just to be transparent: Since I'm working with Zep on the official iOS release, the Android version is going to remain an unofficial side project. However, I still want it to be a quality experience for those of you using it, so I'm pushing these QoL updates to get it stable.

releases.name: recomp-launcher 0.3.0
releases.body:
### Added
- The installer shows its version (the game's tag, or the short commit for a
  build off a branch) in the window's corner and title, and on start asks
  GitHub for the game's newest release: a newer one gets a download button.
  Offline it says nothing.
- `game.files` takes globs: `*.iso` makes a folder holding a disc image the
  game, for a title whose setup takes an image rather than an install.
- `installer.yml` takes `platforms` (default `windows linux macos`), so a
  Windows-only game doesn't publish installers that can't build it.
- A `game.files` entry may be alternatives, `a|b`: `HOVER.EXE|hover*.zip` is
  the game's folder or a folder holding a zip of it.

- The Windows installer carries version info and a manifest, and a release
  has `SHA256SUMS.txt`, so antivirus heuristics and players can check it.
- A log of why the installer stopped (`%APPDATA%\recomp-launcher\launcher.log`
  on Windows), and an error box instead of the window vanishing.

### Fixed
- On Windows a step line after a blank line was glued to the line before it
  (ConPTY skips the blank line with a cursor move), so the bar missed that step.

releases.name: Arceus Native v0.43
releases.body:
## Arceus Native v0.43

### Mali (Arm's own driver): invisible characters and Pokémon (#47, #51, #54, #57, #58)
The player, Pokémon, NPCs and swaying trees are posed by a step that writes their moved vertices into memory before they're drawn. On Arm's own Mali driver that step wrote nothing: the driver doesn't let vertex shaders write to memory, so those models came out empty. Its self-test (in your log since v0.35) showed it plainly: vertex shader writes, nothing; compute shader writes, all of them.

v0.43 does that step another way on such drivers: each vertex is drawn as a single point into a hidden image, then a compute shader copies the results into place. It turns on by itself when your log says `transform feedback captures: as points into colour targets`.

Tested on a Galaxy S25+ with the new way forced on: characters, Pokémon and NPCs drawn, animations right, no crash. **It hasn't run on a Mali phone yet:** please tell us whether your characters are back, and attach `Download/PokemonLegendsArceus-log-previous.txt`.

### Also
- Nothing else changes on Adreno, Xclipse or PowerVR. `DM_VK_TF_POINTS=0` in env.txt turns the new way off, and `1` forces it on any GPU.

releases.name: ExaltDS 0.1.2
releases.body:
**New (experimental)**
- **HD cutscenes from your own video.** If you have your own HD copy of Awakening's anime cutscenes, such as a rip of the *Fire Emblem: HD Movie Collection* Blu-ray or another recording, ExaltDS can play your HD version in place of the game's 400×240 movies. The 3D cutscenes stay as they are.
  - **Nothing is included.** This release contains no HD cutscenes, video files or pictures from the game. ExaltDS only uses the video you choose and your own game file.
  - **How the import works:** in the sidebar, open **Mods / textures**, choose **HD movies from your video…** and pick the video file.
    - ExaltDS decodes the game's own movies from your copy and searches your video for each of the 14.
    - It finds where each one starts, any black bars, how the picture is framed, the frame rate and the brightness, then matches it to the game frame by frame.
    - It then renders the matched frames into HD clips on your device, with the device's own video encoder, and checks each clip.
    - On the AYN Thor this took about 8 minutes for a 15-minute video, with all 14 movies found and 99% of frames in HD. Then use **Apply and restart**.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.1
releases.body:
This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.0
releases.body:
- Fixed DLC imports after the base game is installed, including DLC-only ZIPs/folders and ZIPs left in to_install by older builds (issue #162). Packs are hash-checked in a temporary tree before replacement; previous packs can be recovered after an interrupted replacement.
- Accepted HMM JSON schemas with trailing commas, comments and a UTF-8 BOM; schema errors no longer dump the complete file (issue #93).
- Added a persisted game-storage choice for internal memory, app folders and Android/media folders on mounted volumes, including SD cards. Optional verified copying keeps the original game, mods, settings and saves (issue #90).
- Added missing translations in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese, including mod settings, updates, storage selection and localized file/installer errors.
- Fixed overlapping guest memory copies with `memmove`, addressing the ring crash and broken collision triggers (PR #158 fix by [puopg (Michael Chen)](https://github.com/puopg)).
- Removed the earlier small-block quarantine and collision repair workarounds alongside that fix (PR #158).

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.3
releases.body:
small update

### Vulkan driver profiles

- Added **Adreno 8xx Experimental (sysmem+flushall)** as a separate, non-default launcher choice.
- The new profile uses the bundled whitebelyash Mesa 26.2 gen8-capable driver and forces the exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,flushall` workaround for artifact-prone Adreno 8xx devices.

### Android audio presets

- Added an experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** preset. It reduces the internal FIFO cushion from 16 to 8 guest audio frames (about 85 ms to 43 ms) and requests AAudio's exclusive low-latency path to avoid HyperOS selecting an approximately 80 ms shared hardware burst.
- The existing **Default** and **AYN** behavior is unchanged. The POCO-specific path is opt-in because it may crackle, stall or lose sound on devices whose AAudio/MMAP implementation is unreliable.
- The selected preset, resolved FIFO parameters, AAudio performance/sharing modes, hardware burst, active buffer and platform xrun count are written to the Android log.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.2
releases.body:
### The fix for freezing and crashing on some devices (handhelds like AYN and some Android 13 phones) is still on development. We'll release it as soon as possible

Version 0.5.2 replaces the withdrawn 0.5.1 APK. It includes every user-facing change from 0.5.1, removes performance instrumentation that was unintentionally left enabled there, and adds the following.

### Mod settings (issue #75)

- Mods with an HMM `ConfigSchemaFile` now have their own settings button.
- Boolean, string, integer, floating-point and custom-enum fields are supported, including descriptions, defaults and numeric limits.
- Settings are saved atomically to the mod's INI without discarding unrelated sections, keys or comments.

### In-app updates (issue #83)

- Added periodic update checks and a manual **Check for updates** button.
- The launcher shows release notes and download progress, verifies GitHub's SHA-256 digest when present, and rejects APKs with a different package name or Android signing certificate.
- Installation is handed to Android's system installer; game files, saves, mods and settings stay in place.

### ISO / update / DLC installation (PR #78)

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.1 [REVOKED]
releases.body:
> [!WARNING]
> This APK has been withdrawn. Install [version 0.5.2](https://github.com/SansNope/UnleashedRecomp-Android/releases/tag/v0.5.2) instead.

Version 0.5.1 unintentionally shipped with always-on GPU performance instrumentation that added per-frame timing-query and logging overhead. Its APK asset was removed to prevent further installations.

All legitimate 0.5.1 changes and its full changelog are preserved in the 0.5.2 release and in `CHANGELOG.md`. The tag and this release page remain available for project history.

- **Steam integration and download improvements:** browse the Store and library, install Windows depots, manage downloads, view friends/chat, profile, achievements, badges, and Steam News, and create game shortcuts. releases.name: v1.0.0 — Winlator 适配包
releases.body:
在 Android（[Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator)）与 ARM Linux（Wine + Box64）上运行 DFLegacy 60 版单机端的适配包。

## 包含

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `d3d8.dll` | d3d8to9 v1.15.1 预编译包装层（x86，124 KB） |
| `LICENSE.md` | d3d8to9 的 BSD-3-Clause 许可 |
| `使用说明.md` | 完整部署说明 |
| `放置说明.txt` | 快速上手 |

## 解决什么问题

客户端是 2008 年的 32 位程序，**只认 Direct3D 8**。Android 上的 DXVK 只支持 D3D9 及以上，直接跑会黑屏或崩溃。

这个 `d3d8.dll` 把 D3D8 调用逐条翻译成 D3D9：

```
DNF.exe → d3d8.dll → D3D9 → DXVK → Vulkan → Adreno / Mali
```

绕开 Wine 自带的 `wined3d → OpenGL` 路径，走 Vulkan 后端。

## 用法

1. 解压，把 `d3d8.dll` 复制到 `DNF.exe` 同级目录
2. Winlator 容器里设 `WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d8=n,b`
3. Box86 / Box64 都打开，DXVK 选 2.x
4. 运行 `DNF.exe`

**Windows 本机不要放这个文件** —— 原生 D3D8 路径工作正常，放进去反而改变渲染路径。

## 前提

服务端需要是 x86 构建（NativeAOT `-r win-x86`），否则在纯 32 位环境里加载不了。相关改动见 [DFLegacyAot](https://github.com/Yoshino-Loli/DFLegacyAot)。

## 未验证项

- `ijl15.dll` 的 WIC JPEG 解码在 Wine 下的表现
- Job Object 的退出联动在 Wine 下的可靠性（失败时手动结束服务端即可）

真机帧数需自行测试，骁龙 8 系预期 25~40 fps。

## 不包含

游戏客户端本体与任何受版权保护的资源。`DNF.exe`、`Script.pvf`、`ImagePacks2` 等权利归原权利人所有。

releases.name: Castlevania port v0.5.0
releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

releases.name: Castlevania port v0.4.0
releases.body:
## Save report and update notices

Two new rows in the settings panel (swipe in from the right edge of the screen):

- **Save report** writes a folder `reports/<date>/` into your game folder: the log, a screenshot of the moment you opened the panel, the frame times of the last seconds and basic device information (model, Android version, memory). **Nothing is sent anywhere.** If something looks wrong, open an [issue](https://github.com/IamWilmar/castlevania-recomp/issues) and attach those files (have a look first: the log contains the names of your folders).
- **Update notices** (on by default): about eight seconds after the game starts, the app asks GitHub's public API which release is the latest. It is a single request, without an account, and nothing about you or your game is sent. If there is a newer version, a banner says so and *Get vX.Y.Z* opens its page. Switch it off in the panel (or create an empty file `sin_avisos_version` in the game folder) and the app makes no network request at all.
- Because of the update notices the app now has Android's **Internet** permission. It is used for that request only.

## Installing

releases.name: Castlevania port v0.3.0
releases.body:
## Full screen, without Android's bars

- **Android's navigation bar no longer stays on top of the game.** With three-button navigation (or a visible gesture bar) the bar at the bottom of the screen covered part of the image. The app now hides the system bars while the game runs; swipe in from an edge to bring them up for a moment. Thanks to the player who reported it on a Retroid Pocket 5; it was reproduced and checked on the Flip 2.
- The settings panel opens as before: swipe left from the right half of the screen.
- To keep the bars on screen, create an empty file named `con_barras_sistema` in the game's data folder.

## Installing

Install the APK over the previous version (your settings and saves stay) or follow the [README](https://github.com/IamWilmar/castlevania-recomp#install-and-first-run) for a first install.

releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.body:
## What's new

- **TV mode.** A new switch in the settings panel makes the game run as it does on a TV: the scene renders at 1344×756 instead of 896×504 and the game outputs a full 1080p, so the port no longer has to upscale it. It still holds 60 fps on the Flip 2 (GPU at ~78 %). The controller is then seen as a single wireless controller, which is what the game expects on a TV. The switch takes effect the next time you open the app; an empty `modo_tv` file in the game folder does the same.
- **Bluetooth and USB controllers fixed.** The Retroid's system re-creates every external controller with the device's own IDs, so the port took a DualSense (or any other pad) for the built-in one and, in Retro mode, swapped its buttons. Now the built-in controller is recognised by its name and every other controller is read by position, like on the game's original console: the bottom button is B, whatever mode the device is in.

## Installing

releases.name: Castlevania port v0.1.0
releases.body:
## First public release

A native Android port of the console version of **Castlevania: Belmont's Curse** for the **Retroid Pocket 5** and the **Retroid Pocket Flip 2**, running from your own copy of the game.

- **Playable, early.** Tested on the Flip 2 from the title screen into the prologue (the Paris harbour and the first rooms of the sewers) at 60 fps. It has not been played through yet, so later areas may still show problems.
- **Setup screen.** The app asks for the folder with your extracted game files, checks them and starts the game; it is not tied to one game version (prepared with 1.1.0).
- **Controller modes.** In both of the Retroid's modes (Xbox and Retro) every button does what the button in that same place does on the game's original console, and you can switch modes while the game is running.
- **Settings panel.** Swipe in from the right edge of the screen to slide out a panel with the FPS counter switch and *Change folder*.
- **Straight into the game.** After the first run the app starts the game directly; *Change folder* in the panel, or opening the app twice in a row (within ten seconds), brings the folder screen back.
